command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
echo '== bcftools mpileup + call, whole chr20, NA12878 at 36x =='
T0=$(date +%s)
bcftools mpileup -f chr20.fa -r chr20 NA12878.chr20.30x.bam -Ou 2> bc.log | bcftools call -mv -Oz -o bcftools.vcf.gz 2>> bc.log
T1=$(date +%s)
WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))
bcftools index -f -t bcftools.vcf.gz
NCALL=$(bcftools view -H bcftools.vcf.gz | wc -l)

echo '== score against GIAB HG001 v4.2.1, high-confidence regions =='
bcftools view -R truth.chr20.bed -Ou bcftools.vcf.gz | bcftools norm -f chr20.fa -m -any -Oz -o q.vcf.gz
bcftools view -R truth.chr20.bed -i 'GT="alt"' -Ou truth.chr20.vcf.gz | bcftools norm -f chr20.fa -m -any -Oz -o t.vcf.gz
bcftools index -f q.vcf.gz
bcftools index -f t.vcf.gz
score(){
  local ty=$1
  bcftools view -v "$ty" -i 'QUAL>=30' -Oz -o q.$ty.vcf.gz q.vcf.gz
  bcftools view -v "$ty" -Oz -o t.$ty.vcf.gz t.vcf.gz
  bcftools index -f q.$ty.vcf.gz
  bcftools index -f t.$ty.vcf.gz
  rm -rf is.$ty
  bcftools isec -p is.$ty q.$ty.vcf.gz t.$ty.vcf.gz
  local FP FN TP
  FP=$(grep -vc '^#' is.$ty/0000.vcf || true)
  FN=$(grep -vc '^#' is.$ty/0001.vcf || true)
  TP=$(grep -vc '^#' is.$ty/0002.vcf || true)
  awk -v ty="$ty" -v tp="$TP" -v fp="$FP" -v fn="$FN" 'BEGIN{
    p=(tp+fp)>0?tp/(tp+fp):0; r=(tp+fn)>0?tp/(tp+fn):0; f=(p+r)>0?2*p*r/(p+r):0;
    printf "%s_tp %d\n%s_fp %d\n%s_fn %d\n%s_precision %.5f\n%s_recall %.5f\n%s_f1 %.5f\n",ty,tp,ty,fp,ty,fn,ty,p,ty,r,ty,f }'
}
score snps > snps.kv
score indels > indels.kv
getv(){ awk -v k="$1" '$1==k{print $2}' "$2"; }
SP=$(getv snps_precision snps.kv); SR=$(getv snps_recall snps.kv); SF=$(getv snps_f1 snps.kv)
STP=$(getv snps_tp snps.kv); SFP=$(getv snps_fp snps.kv); SFN=$(getv snps_fn snps.kv)
IP=$(getv indels_precision indels.kv); IR=$(getv indels_recall indels.kv); IF1=$(getv indels_f1 indels.kv)
{
  echo "caller              bcftools (pileup model)"
  echo "wall_s              ${WALL:-NA}  (the caller only, boot and staging excluded)"
  echo "variants_called     ${NCALL:-NA}"
  echo "snv_tp              $STP"
  echo "snv_fp              $SFP"
  echo "snv_fn              $SFN"
  echo "snv_precision       $SP"
  echo "snv_recall          $SR  want >=0.99"
  echo "snv_f1              $SF"
  echo "indel_precision     $IP  OBSERVATION only"
  echo "indel_recall        $IR  OBSERVATION only"
  echo "indel_f1            $IF1  OBSERVATION only"
} > concordance.txt
cat concordance.txt
# Recall is the assertion common to all three callers: a correct 36x call set must find the
# truth variants. Precision is NOT asserted at a common floor, because these are unfiltered
# call sets and the three tools differ enormously in how permissive they are unfiltered --
# which is the finding, not a defect to paper over with a floor each tool happens to clear.
awk -v v="$SR" 'BEGIN{exit !(v>=0.99)}'
test "$STP" -gt 60000
echo 'CONCORDANCE CHECK PASSED'
